entries.zh: 骑马；乘骑牲口
entries.en: to ride on horseback; to ride (an animal)

entries.zh: 骑马而行
entries.en: to ride a horse, to go on horseback

entries.zh: 纵向而行；直走（与「横」相对，不作横斜行走）
entries.en: to go lengthwise, straight ahead (as opposed to crosswise)
entries.notes: 西语词头残损费解（fuera de atravesado 即「不横斜」），义依 H「纵」与「横」之对立而定。

entries.zh: 纵横而行、往来各处；引申（道德语境）为放纵横行、肆无忌惮
entries.en: to go lengthwise and crosswise, to range in all directions; morally, to run rampant, to act unrestrainedly
entries.notes: L 夹拉丁注「et in moralibus」（亦用于道德义），正合「纵横」之引申义「横行无忌」。

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕；疑为绕圈、围成一圈而行（团）
entries.en: 〔damaged original; gloss uncertain〕; possibly to go round, to form a circle
entries.notes: M 栏残，H 首字存疑，L「a ferrador」费解（疑为 al derredor 之讹），仅 R「tûan（团）」可据。

entries.zh: 绕圈而行；围成一圈走（团圆：聚成圆圈）
entries.en: to walk round in a circle, to go around in a ring

entries.zh: 沿直路而行；取最直、最短的路走
entries.en: to walk straight along the road; to take the straightest, shortest way
entries.notes: H 首字「扒」与 R 音 lȳ（履/理）不合，疑抄讹；L「maybreue」当是「mas breve（最短）」。

entries.zh: 横着走；侧身横向而行
entries.en: to walk sideways, to move crosswise

entries.zh: 赶路；加快步伐赶行程
entries.en: to hurry along the road, to make haste on a journey

entries.zh: 驾驭车马；驱车、乘车而行
entries.en: to drive a carriage, to ride in a cart; to drive a horse-drawn vehicle
entries.notes: L「ostella」疑为「o silla（或乘轿）」之讹，R 兼收「驾御/驾驭」两读。

entries.zh: 牙齿松动、外露；龅牙（牙齿突出）
entries.en: for the teeth to be loose and showing; protruding teeth

entries.zh: 碎步而行、小步急走；小跌、踉跄
entries.en: to walk with small, quick steps; to stumble slightly
entries.notes: H「小跌」与 menudito（细碎）义微别，或指碎步中踉跄，两义并存。

entries.zh: 轻快碎步而行；快步轻行
entries.en: to walk with light, quick, short steps

entries.zh: 放轻脚步走；轻步慢行
entries.en: to walk softly, with light steps

entries.zh: 头晕；头昏目眩
entries.en: to be dizzy, to have a swimming head
entries.notes: H 首字存疑（佰/两），L「almodada」疑为「amodorrada」，然「眩」字足定头晕义。

entries.zh: 四肢著地爬行
entries.en: to crawl on all fours

entries.zh: 游方；四处游历、走遍各方
entries.en: to travel about the world, to wander far and wide

entries.zh: 踏遍天下；足迹遍布各地
entries.en: to tread the whole world, to travel all over the earth

entries.zh: 独自步行；亦指阔步缓行、脚步疏阔
entries.en: to walk alone; to walk with long, spaced strides
entries.notes: L「a espaçios y pasos」（脚步疏缓）与 H「独步行」（独自走）义有别，两存之。

entries.zh: 迈大步而行（或快或慢）
entries.en: to take long strides, to walk with big steps (slowly or quickly)

entries.zh: 车轮转动；车轮行走
entries.en: for the wheels of a cart or coach to turn; the wheels to roll
entries.notes: H 第二字存疑（轮/辘），L「cache」疑为「coche（车）」。

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕；疑指跛行、踉跄而行
entries.en: 〔damaged original; gloss uncertain〕; possibly to limp, to stumble along
entries.notes: L「contrabajo」于此费解，H 次字存疑（跤/破），四栏无一致义可定。
